summary: Filter select cannot be operated by keyboard and the error state is a blank area on mobile.

findings.problem: Custom div-based dropdown has no tabindex or key handlers; keyboard users cannot change the filter (accessibility snapshot ev-a11y-0210).
findings.expected_fix: Use the existing components/Select.tsx or a native select with an accessible label.

findings.problem: On forced 500 from /api/history the mobile view renders an empty white area with no message or retry (screenshot ev-shot-0212).
findings.expected_fix: Render the shared ErrorState component with a retry action for failed loads.

checked_criteria: Labels and focus of filter controls

consistency_notes: TypeFilter duplicates components/Select.tsx with a different style
